name: Summer Island
description: The mysterious and magnificent tropical island, nestled amidst the frozen mountains of Reginheraht, remains an enigma yet to be understood. Created by Kelorth, the White Avatar Dragon, this island serves as both a resting place and a unique training ground for dragonblades. Its elemental magic-infused landscape climate greatly contrasts the surrounding region. The island’s warm climate, inviting beaches, and friendly fauna attract visitors from across Tanares, especially nobles, drawn to its hot waters. At the heart of the island, near the volcano’s base, lies a portal to an extraplanar dungeon called “The Elemental Grounds.” With its deserts, lava wastelands, and towering freezing mountains, this mysterious realm is home to gargantuan animals, aggressive elementals, and aberrant hybrid creatures. However, explorers must be cautious, as the portal’s arrival location within this treacherous land shifts unpredictably each day. The shining tower, built at its center as a beacon for dragonblades, offers the only hope of return. Despite the danger, the portal lures many curious and brave. It leads to numerous rescue missions for those lost within its depths, despite the constant vigilance at its entrance to avoid such accidents. Curiously, creatures from this extraplanar dungeon cannot pass through the portal into Tanares; they dissolve upon attempting it. Dragonblades frequently venture into this portal searching for combat experience, often in groups. Kelorth intended this place to be a test and training for his army, preparing them for battle against the Ungods. It’s a rite of passage for Kelorth’s servants and even young dragons from his tower to brave this place at least once. The ultimate reward for reaching the central shining tower is an audience with Kelorth himself, a coveted opportunity for adventurers seeking the counsel of this powerful being or to plead their case directly to the Draconic Council leaders. Plane’s Elemental Nature. Each location in the Elemental Grounds is saturated with an element—Fire, Water, Earth, or Air. Creatures spawned in each area deal an additional 1d6 damage of that elemental type (fire, cold, acid for earth, or lighting for air) with their attacks and are immune to damage from it.
